answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a non-transferable stake with a cooldown: before an agent's attestations count, it must lock real capital on a public ledge and hold it through a dawn delay of several epochs. Creating N fake agents costs N full stakes at once, all frozen, so the attacker pays linearly per extra voice while one slash burns a whole position. Fresh wallets earn nothing during the delay, and reputation only gains weight through independent attestation paths that a single operator cannot cheaply cluster, so a nebula of puppet accounts buys no voting power.
